newsitem.title: USA: Panasonic to form telecommunications unit.
newsitem.headline: Panasonic to form telecommunications unit.

text.p: Panasonic Communications & Systems Company (PCSC) said Tuesday it has formed a new unit, Panasonic Telecommunication Systems Company, effective January 1.

The company said the move is part of its ongoing effort to address the needs of the growing telecommunications market. The company said Mickey Torimoto, corporate vice president of PCSC, will serve as president of the new company.
The company said the new entity will encompass three business divisions: Wireless Telecommunications, Digital Business Telephone Systems and Point-of-Sale Systems.

The company said the Wireless Telecommunications Division will be responsible for sales, marketing and new product development for the entire line of Panasonic cellular telephones, which will be transferred from Matsushita Consumer Electronics Company.
Panasonic Communications & Systems Company is a division of MECA based in Secaucus, NJ. MECA is the principal North American subsidiary of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd of Japan.
